title: MV Does anyone know of a plugin for MV that does this?

posts.author: ondorefilipe
posts.body:
In other words, I'm looking for a plugin for RPG Maker MV that allows the actor's face to be shown in the battle status window, cropped and fitted into each party member's line during battle.
Any help is appreciated!

posts.author: XavionFrost_77
posts.body:
SumRndmDde Battle Status Customizer MV Plugin might work for you. Here's the link.
